title: CODA-MUR: Certified Representation Transport, Composition, and Irreversible Forgetting
description: CODA-MUR (Meta & Universal Re-Presentation) formalizes representation transport, commuting-square composition, and irreversible forgetting within the Calculus of Obstruction, Descent, and Authorization (CODA). A transport certificate chi_F certifies compatibility with observation; it does not confer target standing, which requires target terminalization and target halt guard verification. The manuscript proves reconstruction theorems on ordinary types (composite commutation, collision transport, collision preservation under post-processing, and non-existence of a left inverse recovering every source value after non-injective collapse) mechanized in Lean 4 (0 sorry, 0 admit). An accompanying self-contained Python package implements finite verification of commuting squares, closed 5x5 kind composition, per-leg ledger receipts, strict artifact/regime binding, and verified quotient distance certificates. A general bicategory of all regimes, continuous information loss measures, and recovery of forgotten distinctions are not claimed. This deposit is a new version of concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20280154.
